title: int8-weight-only-compatibility-sanity-suite-and-canary-orchestration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build an automated end-to-end validation and canary orchestration for INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ paths), integrating calibration workflows and accuracy validation into CI/CD and runtime rollouts. This ticket covers the validation harness, smoke matrix, accuracy gates, telemetry queries for drift/regression detection, and an automated canary policy that exercises representative workloads across model families and sequence length buckets. We must ensure compatibility across our kernel selection path, KV cache behavior, and batching settings when a model is served as an INT8 weight-only variant. This includes: - calibration artifacts (per-model calibration records and calibration seed logs) - a deterministic smoke dataset for quick canary checks - nightly regression suites for long-tail accuracy checks - hooks for FP8 baseline comparison and thresholds - playbook for rollback and emergency overrides
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible smoke harness that runs in <= 15 minutes and validates top-1 token accuracy vs FP32 baseline across 20 representative prompts
An automated canary job that can be triggered by CI and via the Console rollout API; succeeds only if accuracy delta <= 1.5% (top-token) and perplexity change <= 3% across the smoke set
Calibration records (calibration.json) are stored in the quant-profile registry and include per-layer scale metadata and seed/hash for determinism
Nightly regression job produces a drift report and flags any model where metric deltas exceed configured thresholds (alerts to #quantization-alerts Slack and creates ENG ticket when high impact)
A documented rollback playbook and an automated policy to revert traffic to a compatible floating-point variant when canary fails or SLO regressions are detected
test_plan: Smoke matrix: 20 prompts covering instruction, completion, code, multi-turn and short/long token contexts; run across 3 model families (Llama2-13B, Falcon-40B, Mistral-7B) in single-token and 2048-token contexts
Calibration workflow: run GPTQ and AWQ calibration with 3 different seeds; capture calibration artifacts and verify reproducibility via hash checks
Stress cases: batched requests (1, 8, 32), streaming vs non-streaming paths, KV cache warm/warm-hot transitions, and continuous-batching windows at different latencies
Nightly regression: 2000-example eval set (public + internal), produce top-token accuracy,ROUGE/EM where applicable, and perplexity; compare against FP32 baseline and previous nightly
CI gating: lightweight per-PR smoke that runs on a small subset and blocks merges if gating thresholds fail
rollout_plan: Step 1 (canary): deploy INT8 weight-only variant with 0.5% traffic and run smoke harness; hold for 30 minutes
Step 2 (extended canary): if Step 1 passes, increase to 5% traffic and run the full smoke matrix and observability checks for 2 hours
Step 3 (staged ramp): if Step 2 passes, automatically ramp to 25% over 6 hours with continuous accuracy sampling; monitor token-level delta and latency SLOs
Step 4 (full): if no regressions at 25% after 12 hours, release to 100% or leave as deploy-time config for customers to pin
Abort/rollback: any accuracy gate breach or latency/P95 SLO breach triggers immediate revert to the previous floating-point variant and creates a postmortem ticket
telemetry_queries: Top-token-accuracy-delta: SELECT model, variant, date, avg(top_token_match_fp32) FROM quant_eval WHERE variant='int8_wo' GROUP BY model,variant,date
Perplexity-diff: compute ratio of perplexity(int8) / perplexity(fp32) per eval-batch
Latency-by-batch: percentile(latency_ms) grouped by batch_size and sequence_length for int8 vs fp32
Calibration-coverage: count(calibration_artifact_version) per model in quant-profile registry
Drift-alerts: query for nightly_regression.delta > threshold and send to #quantization-alerts
notes: Trade-offs: tighter accuracy threshold reduces risk but increases rollback probability for models with high sensitivity; AWQ shows slightly better latency in preliminary runs but GPTQ has more stable repeatability across seeds. We will collect per-seed variance and consider adding seed-averaged calibration bundles if single-seed instability is > 0.5% top-token delta. Also need to coordinate with Storage team for calibration artifact retention policy (currently 90 days may be insufficient).
